_readme: Measurement plan: the single source of truth for what js/analytics.js pushes to window.dataLayer. Gate G13 drives a real browser and checks the dataLayer against this file (names, parameters, no personal data, every event actually fires). _tools/build-gtm.mjs generates the Google Tag Manager container and its README from it.
allowedHostsNote: Only these hostnames may report to analytics. The page snippet (index.html) and the GTM container (build-gtm.mjs) both read this list; a copy of the site on any other domain stays out of the data. Add a custom domain here, then run: node build-gtm.mjs G-6TKSCE8X4Q

constraints._note: GA4 limits: event name <= 40 chars, parameter name <= 40, value <= 100, <= 25 parameters per event. Names are snake_case.

site_language.about: Language the page was showing when the event happened (en, pt, es). Added to every event.

item.about: What the event is about; the event name says what kind of thing it is (a section, a stat, a filter, a case card, a project, a carousel, a skill).

slide.about: Slide shown by a carousel: the role id for the experience carousel, a number for the others.

location.about: Where on the page the clicked element lives: a section id, header or footer.

method.about: How: email (the icon at the top), email_hiring, email_projects (the two paths of the Contact section), linkedin, github (contact_click) or pointer, keyboard (language_toggle).

link_type.about: company, event, episode, project, certificate_verify or other.

link_domain.about: Host of the outbound link (never the full URL).

cv_language.about: Language of the CV file that was downloaded.

browser_language.about: Primary language of the browser: en, pt, es or other. Compare with site_language to see who needs a translation.

seconds.about: Active seconds spent in a section (tab visible and the visitor active in the last 20 s).

total_seconds.about: Total active seconds in the page view.

sections_seen.about: How many sections were read for 2+ seconds.

message.about: js_error: the error message (own scripts only, 100 chars).

via.about: Where a navigation click came from: bar (desktop), dropdown (hamburger menu) brand (the logo) or glance (a row of the career-at-a-glance list).

site_context.when: Once per page view, after the language is resolved.

language_toggle.when: The visitor switches language with the EN | PT | ES buttons.

cv_download.when: Click on a CV download button.

contact_click.when: Click on e-mail (the top icon, or the Hiring / Projects button of the Contact section), LinkedIn or GitHub.

outbound_click.when: Click on a link that leaves the site (company, event, episode, project, Credly).

nav_click.when: Click on the logo, a navigation link or a row of the career-at-a-glance list (via glance, item = the role id).

menu_toggle.when: Open or close of the hamburger menu (small screens).

impact_stat_click.when: Click on a number of the Impact section.

case_filter.when: A theme filter of the case studies is chosen.

case_view.when: A case card stays 2 s on screen (60% visible), once per card.

project_open.when: A project of the earlier-projects carousel is opened.

carousel_navigate.when: A carousel moves to another slide.

training_toggle.when: The full list of courses (item courses) or the early machine learning projects (item early_projects) is opened or closed.

skill_hover.when: The pointer rests 0.5 s on a skill tag (once per skill, at most 15 per visit).

section_view.when: A section is under the middle of the screen for 2 active seconds (once per section).

section_dwell.when: The tab is hidden or closed: one event per section with 3+ active seconds.

scroll_depth.when: 25, 50, 75 and 100% of the page height reached.

engagement_summary.when: The tab is hidden or closed: totals for the visit so far.

js_error.when: A script of this site throws (at most 3 per visit).

forbiddenInValues._note: Nothing that identifies a person may ever travel in an event: e-mail addresses, phone numbers, the full name, free text typed by the visitor.
